description: This file implements runtime tracing and graph transformation functions for PyTorch's JIT compiler, including node tracing, loop and if handling, and graph instrumentation.

classes.name: TracingData
classes.description: Helper structure maintaining mappings between scripted and traced graph values, and holding the traced graph.

methods.name: traceNode
methods.description: Creates a traced node corresponding to a scripted node, copying metadata and mapping outputs.

methods.name: eraseAllOutputs
methods.description: Removes all outputs from a given node.

methods.name: createPropNodeForIfBlock
methods.description: Creates a propagate node for if-else blocks to map outputs between branches and the if node.

methods.name: traceLoopCounter
methods.description: Handles explicit tracing of loop counters for iterative control flow.

methods.name: traceLoop
methods.description: Handles tracing of loop nodes, propagating inputs and outputs across iterations.

methods.name: insertTracingNodes
methods.description: Inserts tracing nodes into a block, handling control flow constructs like ifs and loops.

methods.name: TraceGraph
methods.description: Main function to create a traced graph from a scripted graph, involving inlining, dead code elimination, profiling, and node tracing.
